title: Item:Bigby's Guiding Hand
wikitext:
__NOTOC__{{Top}} {| | rowspan="2" | [[File:Bigby's Blue Guiding Hand icon.png|60px|left]] | '''5''' ''for'' {{Cost|5|inline=TRUE}} |- | '''25''' ''for'' {{Cost|20|inline=TRUE}} |} Bigby's Guiding Hand is a consumable available from the [[DDO Store#Questing_Tools|DDO Store]] and [[Daily Dice]] rolls. Originally introduced as part of the {{Item|Traveler's Terrific Trunk}} bundle, it was later made available for separate purchase as well. This item creates a glowing hand where the caster is standing, which points in the direction the caster is facing. A "searchlight" of the same color rises from hand, making it easier to see from a distance. The hand is marked on the map with an X of the same color. Once placed, the hand lasts for an hour and cannot be moved or dismissed. (When cast in a [[wilderness]] area, the hand disappears when area has reset; however, the X on the map sometimes persists into the next instance.) The Hand is available in [[#Bigby's_Blue_Guiding_Hand|blue]], [[#Bigby's_Green_Guiding_Hand|green]], [[#Bigby's_Orange_Guiding_Hand|orange]], [[#Bigby's_Purple_Guiding_Hand|purple]], [[#Bigby's_Red_Guiding_Hand|red]], [[#Bigby's_White_Guiding_Hand|white]], and [[#Bigby's_Yellow_Guiding_Hand|yellow]] in packs of 5 for {{Cost|5|inline=true}} or 25 for {{Cost|20|inline=true}}. Cannot be used in public areas.
